steps.line: Static scratches behind your ear. A young man's voice, reading too quickly from a page, cuts off — then comes back careful, almost apologetic.
Layla? Sorry. That was a prep pass — not meant for your line.
The handler on your channel. I can hear you, but I'm not in the cave with you.
And since you're awake — the chalk: draw a closed ring around one of the marked units. When the ring closes, it follows you. Capture the cave, reach the bottom. The rules are in the floor.
